title: People’s Mañanera September 14
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity’s Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available[here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Housing for Those Who Have Never Been Able to Afford It  
** Housing policy transforms lives: 5.17 million homeowners are no longer
burdened with unpayable loans; 52% of the new homes are for women, and 88% are
for those earning up to 1.5 times the minimum wage. “It’s about accessing a
right,” President Claudia Sheinbaum explained.

**Decent Housing and Secure Property  
** The goal is to issue at least one million property deeds, providing
certainty to families who have gone without them for up to 30 years. In
addition, Constitutional Article 4 recognizes adequate housing as a right. The
Infonavit and Fovissste housing agencies have regained the authority to build
housing for the people.

**Entry-level Housing vs. Speculation  
** The President charged that some governments are driving gentrification
through corruption and violations of land-use and zoning regulations. This is
the case with the Real Estate Cartel in the Benito Juárez borough in Mexico
City. In response to this situation, Sheinbaum indicated that “we are building
entry-level housing.”

**Sovereignty: Mexico Is No One’s Punching Bag  
** Sheinbaum noted that “the vast majority of Mexicans are against foreign
intervention. We will always defend the principle of non-interference.”
Indeed, polls show that 91% of Mexicans oppose foreign intervention.

**The People, Sovereignty, and National Pride  
** More than 300,000 people have accompanied the President in her visits
around the country in which she reports on the balance sheet of government
activity and future plans. “When a people recognizes its strength and its
history, there is nothing that can stop it,” Sheinbaum declared.
